visualCharacteristics.purpose: Single collapsed text disclosure for secondary article content (references, video transcript)
visualCharacteristics.description: Underlined blue "Show references" / "Show transcript" label with a chevron; opens to reveal the body text below. No borders or panel background.

contentPattern.structure: One row: label | body (paragraphs or list)
contentPattern.description: Source JS expando becomes a native details/summary, collapsed by default. The label is shown verbatim, so author the full visible text ("Show references", "Show transcript"). Extra rows render as extra toggles.

usage: One collapsible item after the article (references) or after an in-article video (transcript).
reuseGuidance: Use for a single show/hide text toggle. For a bordered multi-item FAQ use the base accordion block.
